spec.assertion: Exactly 4 true-flavored hits land at frame<=6, before any burst. Fails under the nearest-wrong readings 'one proc' (count 1) or 'repeating/interval summon' (count grows over the fight). Coefficient sensitivity proven by halving the 90.81 atkPct.

buffApply targeting ein with value 70.12 and expiresFrame-frame === 600 (10s@60fps). Fails under a permanent model (deleting durationSec strictly raises ein's total) and under an ally-scoped model (teammates stay byte-identical when the buff is stripped).

Trigger identity stageEnter{3} vs ein's own burstCast is NOT discriminable in controlComp (ein is the actual burster, so both fire identically). it.skip with the reason; needs a two-B3 comp where a different B3 completes the chain.

Every battle-start feather hit carries the true bucket/flavor; halving atkPct lowers ein's total; stripping the effect leaves liter/crown/helm byte-identical (enemy-targeted, no ally payload). Fails under a plain flatDamage (non-true) encoding and under any ally-scoped reading.

buffApply stat chargeDamagePct value 80 with durationShots===1 and NO expiresFrame — a ROUND-COUNT window. Fails under the nearest-wrong durationSec model (patching to durationSec:10 strictly raises ein's total). Re-application count >5 proves the per-full-charge trigger is live (non-vacuity).
>=6 true hits in the cast-frame window per ein burst cast (6 feathers + the 300.02% nuke). Fails under the nearest-wrong 'copy skill1's 4' reading.

Self-targeted trueDamagePct 55.3 with a 600-frame window; zeroing it lowers ein's total (proves it actually feeds the feather/nuke true hits); stripping it leaves teammates byte-identical (Affects self, not a team buff).
Self-targeted chargeDamagePct 140.68 with a 600-frame window, distinct from the skill2b 80 (asserted by value filter so the two are never conflated). Teammate byte-identity pins the self scope.

One true-flavored hit at each ein burst-cast frame; reducing atkPct to 0.02 drops ein's total. fbMajorApplied falsy (burst-cast instant damage is FB-exempt) and rangeApplied falsy (riders take no +30%). Fails under the nearest-wrong 'x10 targets = x10 instances' reading and under an FB-eligible encoding.

Single partless boss — the target clause collapses to 'the boss'; DEF-ranking and the 10-count are unobservable. Pinned indirectly as ONE instance per cast; it.skip records the selection rule as untestable here.

fixtures: controlComp('ein', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / ein B3 / helm B3, boss Fire, focus ein. helm=true is required, not optional: ein is a Burst III and a lone B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts, which would make every burst-slot assertion vacuous. helm is kept (rather than helm=false) because none of ein's lines are read through a crit/charge magnitude that helm's buffs would confound — every burst/skill assertion is either an event-field read (stat/value/expiresFrame/durationShots/bucket/fbMajorApplied) or a same-fixture counterfactual delta, both of which are invariant to a constant support baseline. Fixture non-vacuity is asserted explicitly (ein casts >0 bursts, >0 fullBurstStart, ein totalDamage >0). All counterfactuals go through withPatchedOverride so the committed JSON is never touched (parallel-run safe); 8 hoisted runComp calls total.
gaps: skill1b trigger identity (stageEnter{stage:3} vs ein's own burstCast) — indistinguishable in a fixture where ein is the actual burster; needs a comp where a different B3 completes the chain into stage 3. This is the single highest-risk divergence in the unit: keying it to burstCast OVER-CREDITS in any multi-B3 team, while stageEnter fires on any team chain into stage 3.

Near Feather summon indirection — skill2a's trigger is 'when Near Feather is summoned' but the engine has no summon entity/event, so any faithful encoding folds the 90.81% true hit into the summoning block (4x skill1a, 6x burst). Count and timing are pinned; the indirection itself (feather persistence, a third summon source, re-trigger) is unobservable.

Target-selection clauses ('1 random enemy', '10 enemy units with the highest final DEF') — the scope-lock fight is a single partless boss, so both collapse to 'the boss'. Per-cast instance COUNT is pinned instead.

⚑ Feather noFb / noRange conventions are MEASUREMENT-GATED. Per-kit noFb is measured-only. The 4 battle-start feathers land outside any Full Burst (flag unobservable there); the 6 burst feathers land at the cast frame where burst-instant FB-exemption already applies. Whether feathers landing inside an FB window should take the +50% major needs popup evidence — flagged with the recipe, not guessed.

⚑ Cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / SR pulls-per-sec) comes from datamine fields on the known-unreliable list, and skill2b's per-full-charge re-application count depends on it directly. The count assertion is written as a loose lower bound (>5) rather than an exact number so it pins the mechanic without pinning an unverified cadence.
